title: Browser
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production transparent PNG sprite, whole object centered, square with narrow transparent margins. This is a dimensional interactive Applet for a cozy miniature village. Not a flat icon sheet. Soft painted matte enamel, rounded sculptural relief, restrained timber/brass/ivory accents. Gentle fixed view about 18 degrees sideways and 25 degrees downward, logo front dominant. Soft upper-left daylight. No landscape, no floor island, no big furniture, no flowers, no extra branding badges or duplicate logos, no fake counts or UI text. The original icon must be immediately recognizable at 84 pixels. Icon sculpture occupies 75-85% of visible mass; just ONE or TWO tiny functional additions at base/side. Do NOT invent a generic machine and place a little logo on it. Not glossy plastic, not steampunk. Subject: Browser. Image1 is the existing unbranded device identity to preserve but simplify. A dominant blue and sage globe, dimensional and rounded, on a minimal walnut/brass stand. No magnifying glass, no browser brand. Images2/3 show accepted village materials and logo-first hierarchy. Do not include screenshot backgrounds, watermarks or labels outside the object.

baseRevision.prompt: Edit this browser Applet figurine: Replace the narrow stacked circular stand with a broader low oval wooden foot, solid and stable under the globe. Retain the brass globe meridian mount. Avoid tall tiers. Shared base design: warm medium honey timber, softly rounded wooden edges, subtle woodgrain, restrained brass fasteners, no stone or ivory rim, low solid support about 10–15% height. Match existing village miniature style, upper-left soft light. Preserve the original device, logo, colors, functions and gentle screen-left-facing view with right side visible. Keep verticals upright and object firmly supported. Base only slightly wider than device. No added scenery or text. Entire object centered with safe margins on true transparent background.

lampRevision.prompt: Precisely edit the attached browser Applet miniature. Preserve the existing entire device, correct original logo, functional accessories, wooden base, camera angle, silhouette, materials, color and framing. Add exactly ONE clearly visible status indicator recessed in the FRONT FACE of the wooden base, centered horizontally on that FRONT FACE (not the side), near its vertical center. It is a small warm brass circular bezel with a plain BLACK charcoal glass center, switched OFF: absolutely no glow, no colored light. Black lens diameter approximately 4% of total image width, bezel outside diameter 5%; slightly oblique oval consistent with front face perspective. Make sure unobstructed by props. If existing small indicator occupies base front center replace it with this unlit black lens; remove other colored status indicators on the base, retain brand graphics and non-status functional parts. If support has no continuous wood front, add a discreet low timber connecting foot with the socket at center, otherwise do not redesign base. No extra text, labels, dots, buttons or scenery. Full object isolated on true transparent background. Preserve 1024-or-1280 square composition and safe margins.
